name: Blue Rocks Cafe & Grill, Nature’s Valley
address: St, 135 St Michaels Ave, Natures Valley, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Relaxed forest café serving grills, burgers and craft beers in the heart of Nature's Valley.
description_long:
Tucked into the ancient Tsitsikamma forest, Blue Rocks Cafe & Grill is Nature's Valley's social hub where locals and hikers gather over cold drinks and hearty plates. The laid-back atmosphere suits the setting perfectly — wooden tables, forest views, and a menu built around flame-grilled favourites and generous burgers that fuel outdoor adventures.

The kitchen keeps things straightforward with quality grills, fresh line fish when available, and proper pub-style comfort food. Their burger selection draws regulars, while the beer selection features local craft brews alongside the usual suspects. It's the kind of place where you settle in after a day on the Otter Trail or a swim at the lagoon.

Conveniently located on St Michaels Avenue, it's an easy stop whether you're based in the village or passing through between Plettenberg Bay and Storms River. The casual vibe welcomes families, groups, and solo travellers equally — perfect for those seeking good food without pretension in one of the Garden Route's most beautiful forest settings.
